::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [12 January 1866]  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Clare Roels
:::

My dear [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd),
I should have said that I think you must specify your stones, there are such a frightful number- Pray have opal and turquoise- One for its weird history, the other for its nature- but exclude all the stupid ones, like garnets &c or we shall be swamped - I shall send the parcel on Monday - Meantime I send you the grand Goslings acceptance[^1] - I think [Fernseed](people/person_1160.qmd) must be her name - [Ladyfern](people/person_455.qmd) & [Magpie](people/person_896.qmd) keep on after all. This Fernseed is to be directed to as 

Miss Peard
Sparnow
Torquay

your affectionate
Mother Goose

---

[^1]: Endorsed ‘January 12 1866’.
[^2]: Frances Peard’s answer to CMY’s request that she join the [Gosling Society](organizations/other_104.qmd).
